race.comment: VINTAGE STAR (3) disappointed when in the market here last time but was good two back. Gets a key switch to Toeroek, who often gets the best out of him. Bold showing anticipated fourth up. THE MAGISTRATE (8) is going better than his form reads and doesn't need to improve much down at this weight to be right there late. GRAND HOST (1) hasn't won for a long time but is knocking on the door and deserves each-way respect. NICEREINE (4) continues to race well and should be considered a winning hope. Bendigo run and rating stands up okay against these and should be able to work into a handy position in the running.
